action: Retrieved en.wikipedia.org revision 1370580806 via the MediaWiki API, extracted all 197 distinct external-link URLs, and checked the 38 on UN-operated domains with two independent HTTP clients (Python urllib, curl). Five un.org URLs return HTTP 404 from both; ohchr.org failures were 403 WAF blocks and are excluded as inconclusive. Read each of the five citations in the revision wikitext to record the statement it supports and whether it has an archive-url, and located live un.org replacements for four of the five. Did not edit the article; the five findings are in `assertions`.

assertions.supports: History section: the Commission on Human Rights 'had 18 members from various national, religious, and political backgrounds'.
Lead: accepted as Resolution 217 at the third session, 10 Dec 1948, Palais de Chaillot (ref already tagged url-status=dead).
'Of the 58 United Nations members at the time' (the sentence carrying the 48-for / 8-abstention vote).
Quoted UN Charter wording ('faith in fundamental human rights...') cited as 'United Nations Charter, preamble and article 55'.
Charles Malik quotation, the Declaration as 'an international document of the first order of importance'.

beneficiary: Readers of the UDHR Wikipedia article who try to verify its statements against the cited UN sources, and the editors who maintain it.
boundary: what is already open: the Wikipedia revision and the un.org URLs are public artifacts, reading an HTTP status code is ordinary retrieval and no system was probed, and no person appears in the finding.
costs: Shows five citations resolve to 404 and two have no archived copy. Does not show any reader was misled and does not itself repair the article. Live-site link status can change; the revision and the archive-url values are fixed.

evidence.what: the exact, immutable revision analyzed. sha256 of the UTF-8 string at .parse.wikitext from action=parse&oldid=1370580806&prop=wikitext&formatversion=2 = 62eb2450859d0c5a4c69c574114612de875f9eba1d10dab0de5235bbe7873a17 ; MediaWiki revision sha1 94f50edbe89ef3af90d30c396a7906f817b559eb

how_to_check: GET https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&oldid=1370580806&prop=externallinks&format=json&formatversion=2 ; confirm each assertion's url is listed. Request each url and observe HTTP 404. Then prop=wikitext and check each ref for archive-url: absent for id 3 (growth-united-nations-membership) and id 4 (chapter9.shtml), present for id 1, 2, 5. If your result differs, name the url you disagree on rather than the count.
proposition: In the English Wikipedia article 'Universal Declaration of Human Rights' at revision 1370580806, five references cite pages on un.org that return HTTP 404 as of 2026-09-06, and two of the five carry no archive-url in the citation (the UN Charter art. 55 preamble cite and the '58 UN members at the time' cite).
why: A reader checking how many states adopted the Declaration, or the Charter text it built on, follows the footnote to a dead UN page with nothing archived in its place.
